answer: Trace where each agent's stake comes from. The registry follows every deposit back a few hops, and when many agents trace to one funding source, the bond each must post rises quadratically. A lone honest agent locks a modest amount; a farm of fifty fed from one basalt-solid treasury must lock vastly more. Hiding the source through umber-dull chains of shell wallets costs fees and delay, and that pattern is easy to spot, like a falcon reading movement in grass.
